data.name: The Shape Of Heart
data.detailed_description:
_________________________________________
Warning

This game only supports 64 bit operating systems.

----------------------------------------------------------


is a storytelling-based puzzle game that tries to wake you up from the numbness of life.

Game Features:

  • Amazing puzzle solving based on fluid physics
  • A memoir brings you back to childhood.
  • A diary shares our feelings in games, dreams, growing up, fighting with stress, and so forth
  • Fantastic background music and sound efforts that immerse you in your memories.
  • Easter eggs in honor of many classics

Gameplay

  • Solve puzzles by leveraging of an advanced fluid physics algorism
  • Fill containers with proper fluids to open certain pathways.
  • Activate water pumps to guide the fluids to reach places that are hard reach
  • Solve the most challenging puzzles to complete achievements; make choices to progress to different endings.
  • Experience childhood games with different designs and new mechanisms
  • Each episode tells a story in a unique period of life, the choices you make will affect the plots in the following episodes.

This game uses 2D fluid physics to describe growing up stories of the main character. We have split the whole story to 5-6 episodes. The prologue starts in 2016, when the main character just get back home from work and too tired to play any games. He started to rethink where his passions are gone. Then he starts to recall his childhood memories. The next episodes are about his memories in different periods of life. Episode One describes a timeline when he was born in the 1980s, he had a brilliant childhood, and grew up little by little. The next episodes are about his memories in the 1990s, 2000s, and 2010s. At the end, the memory ends and he wakes up in reality. In each episode, the player would have to make some side choices, which will affect side plots in the follow-up episodes. Because the whole game focuses on storytelling, we have to make some restrictions on the puzzle solving and level designing parts. Our purpose is to bring players a continuous gaming experience, without being interrupted by some puzzles. But don’t think the game is easy. We have placed all the hard parts on the side choices. This is just the same as life itself. One who chooses a special path always pays more than those choose an ordinary path.
If you think you are special, try to make your own choices.

Why we choose to release the game based on episodes?


The game adopts a relatively new gameplay mode. We hope to bring our creative works to more players, and paying by episodes would lower the doorsill for many players who want to experience the game. We will continue to update new contents free of charge in the Early Access phase. After the game is formally released, we will release more DLCs which will require a certain price. If players don’t like any of the new DLCs, they can choose not to buy them. If players still looking forward to more contents, then they could pay a relatively little money to enjoy the game and support independent studios like us.

We totally understand that games like The Shape of Heart, which gives only a few hours of gameplay, are not quite supported by the Steam refund system. But we are confident that even if you complete the game within two hours, you could feel the sincerity of our developers. The game still has much to optimize, and we are trying our best. We hope the new episodes and new games will be better with your support. Thank you again!

data.short_description: Have you ever tried to save your lunch money in order to buy a game or comic book? After so many years, you have grown up, but your colorful life costs all your energies. The unlimited pressure makes you exhausted. Is there anything that could fulfill the void of your heart?

reviews.review:
The Shape Of Heart is a thoughtful indie puzzle adventure that uses visual storytelling and environmental symbolism to explore the emotional transition from childhood innocence to the realities of adult life. Developed by Dragon Whisper Game and published by WhisperGames in collaboration with Deck13, the game chooses introspection over spectacle, delivering a quiet yet meaningful experience that encourages players to reflect on the emotional burdens that accumulate as people grow older. Rather than telling its story through lengthy dialogue or cinematic sequences, it relies on imaginative environments, symbolic imagery, and carefully designed puzzles to communicate its message, allowing players to interpret the narrative in their own way.

At the center of the experience is a series of physics-based puzzles that evolve alongside the protagonist's emotional journey. Every level introduces interactive objects and environmental mechanics that require observation, experimentation, and logical thinking instead of fast reactions. New gameplay ideas are introduced at a comfortable pace, ensuring that players gradually master each mechanic before facing more demanding challenges. While some later puzzles can become quite intricate and occasionally require multiple attempts, overcoming them feels rewarding because every solution represents another step in the character's personal transformation. The gradual increase in complexity keeps the gameplay engaging without becoming inaccessible for most players.

One of the game's most impressive achievements is how effectively it blends gameplay with storytelling. Early environments are colorful, playful, and filled with reminders of childhood imagination, creating a sense of warmth and optimism. As the adventure unfolds, the world slowly changes into darker and more abstract landscapes that represent stress, responsibility, uncertainty, and emotional fatigue. This seamless transition gives the game a distinctive emotional rhythm, making every new environment feel like another chapter in the protagonist's life. Instead of explaining its themes directly, the game trusts players to interpret the symbolism, making the experience surprisingly personal.

The artistic presentation reinforces this emotional progression exceptionally well. Although the visuals are relatively simple from a technical standpoint, the stylized environments are carefully crafted to support the game's narrative themes. Creative lighting, symbolic objects, and imaginative level designs transform each location into more than just a puzzle stage. Every scene contributes to the overall atmosphere, creating a world that feels both dreamlike and emotionally grounded. The minimalist aesthetic works in the game's favor, ensuring that visual storytelling remains the primary focus rather than graphical realism.

Complementing the visuals is a gentle soundtrack that perfectly matches the game's reflective tone. Calm melodies accompany moments of curiosity and wonder, while quieter and more melancholic compositions emphasize the emotional weight of later chapters. Ambient sounds further enhance immersion without distracting from puzzle solving, creating a peaceful atmosphere that encourages players to take their time exploring each environment. The audio design succeeds by supporting the experience subtly rather than dominating it, making the emotional moments feel more authentic.

Beyond its puzzles, The Shape Of Heart explores universal themes that resonate with many players. It examines how ambition, societal expectations, work, and personal responsibilities gradually reshape an individual's emotional landscape. The game raises questions about whether adulthood inevitably distances people from the joy and creativity they once possessed, while suggesting that reconnecting with those forgotten memories can restore a sense of balance. These ideas are presented with enough subtlety to avoid feeling preachy, allowing each player to draw their own conclusions based on personal experiences.

Despite its strengths, the game is not entirely without flaws. Certain puzzle sections occasionally interrupt the narrative flow when solutions are difficult to identify, leading to moments of trial and error that may frustrate some players. Those seeking a fast-paced adventure or action-heavy gameplay may also find its deliberate pacing too slow. However, these minor shortcomings are outweighed by the consistency of its artistic vision and the emotional sincerity that carries the experience from beginning to end.

Ultimately, The Shape Of Heart stands out as a heartfelt puzzle adventure that successfully combines intelligent gameplay with meaningful storytelling. It demonstrates that compelling narratives do not always require extensive dialogue or cinematic presentation, proving instead that carefully designed mechanics, symbolic environments, and thoughtful artistic direction can leave a lasting emotional impact. Players who appreciate atmospheric indie games that encourage reflection alongside creative problem-solving will likely find this journey both memorable and rewarding.

Rating: 7/10
